items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I had out of that band singing like Fred Waring and his Pennsylvanians.

ctx.x: That '33 -- but I had a band --oh, but you haven't gottento that yet. I'll tell you about that band. That band was something else. It was the band that -- I think it was Walter Winchell said, (unintelligible) Louis Armstrong and his band. And I had out of that band singing like Fred Waring and his Pennsylvanians.
